latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Image to Video Luma" skill:

- Instantly animate still images into cinematic 1080p MP4 video clips using AI cloud rendering.
- Simple upload and prompt-driven workflow—no manual sliders or editing required.
- Handles popular image formats (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 20MB).
- Automatic free session setup with 100 credits; guides users through token and upload steps.
- Supports timeline editing, track summaries, and fast export/download of video results.
- Clear handling of common error codes and feedback messages for a smooth user experience.
